title: How Many Dragons to BEAT Stockfish?
summary: How many Dragons to beat Fairy-Stockfish (a throwback: 11 months earlier it took seven): White has only a king plus N Dragons (bishop + knight) against Fairy-Stockfish's full army; one more dragon after every loss. Loses with 1-5 dragons, wins with six.
rules: White: king + N dragons, nothing else (0:49).
Start with 1 dragon, add one after each loss (1:27, 2:22, 3:17, 4:01, 8:46).
win_condition: Checkmate Fairy-Stockfish; find the minimum number of dragons needed.
